t0 registers (0.005 SOL from the game balance)

a tenth player is refused: the tournament is full (TourneyFull)
a player leaves before the start: the fee comes back
...exactly 0.005 SOL back in the game balance

a non-host can't fund the prize (NotCreator)
anyone can read the tournament (public): 9 registered, the prize and every fee owed
the keeper created, opened and linked the 2 tables a minute before the start
its tables have 8 seats and name the keeper as their rent payer
a tournament table refuses a buy-in (it holds chips, never money)
starting before the start time is refused (TourneyTooEarly)
registering after the start time is refused (TourneyClosed)
at the start time anyone (this test, or the keeper first) starts it: the VRF is asked for the seat draw
the VRF callback drew the seats: 9 players over 2 eight-seat table(s), every seat distinct
syncing a table before its round is seated is refused (review H1)
a tournament that's moving can't be abandoned (review M1)
Sit out is refused at a tournament table (review H2)
a player's key can't take another entrant's table key (InvalidReader)
an outsider's play key can't move anyone's registration (NotRegistered)
a lost table key is replaced by the play key: the registration and the seat move to the new key
...and the old key no longer finds the seat (it can't read the ledger or act)
the tournament finished: a champion and a runner-up
every player got a distinct finishing place 1..9
it took two rounds (the tables, then the final table)
the table-key swap ran (a seated player was found between hands)
the keeper dealt hands while no player started one (tables with players away keep moving)
a player who sent no seed was still dealt in (absent players are blinded away, not skipped)
...and its turns ran out after 3 s, not 15
anyone (this test, or the keeper first) pays out: champion, runner-up and the 5% platform fee
the champion got 27450000 (60% of the pool after the fee)
the runner-up got 18300000 (40%)
prizes + fee = host prize + entry fees, exactly
paid once: the tournament owes nothing; a second payout is refused
only the host can cancel (NotCreator)
the host cancels before the start
registering in a cancelled tournament is refused
anyone refunds the player
anyone refunds the host's prize
a second refund is refused (NothingOwed)
both game balances are back where they started
after the payout the keeper closed the tables and reclaimed their rent on Solana
...then closed the tournament and returned its rent to the host
the keeper got its table rent back (net cost under 0.01 SOL per table, the locked permission rent aside)
